breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.name_zh: 原发中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
master.definition_en: A non-Hodgkin or Hodgkin lymphoma that arises in the brain or spinal cord as a primary lesion. There is no evidence of lymphoma outside the central nervous system at the time of diagnosis.

orphanet_prevalence_list.source: Central Brain Tumor OTHERistry of the United States 2010-2014[OTHER]_29117289[PMID]

curated.name_zh: 原发中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
aliases_zh: 中枢神经系统弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤
curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 中枢神经系统侵袭性淋巴瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 罕见但高度侵袭性的结外淋巴瘤（90%–95%为弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤，常携带MYD88 L265P/CD79B突变），肿瘤在脑实质深部快速浸润生长，未治中位生存仅1.5–3个月；一旦并发重度脑水肿或脑疝，可在数小时至数日内因呼吸中枢受压死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 虽然起病极凶险，但与胶质母细胞瘤不同，PCNSL对大剂量甲氨蝶呤(HD-MTX)为基础的化疗高度敏感！适合强化治疗的年轻患者经“HD-MTX诱导+自体干细胞移植(ASCT)或减量全脑放疗”巩固，5年生存率可达50%–65%，部分患者可实现长期临床治愈。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN未从NHL/CNS肿瘤中单列PCNSL；全球年发病率约4–5/百万（占原发脑肿瘤约2%–3%、占NHL约1%–2%），免疫功能正常老年人发病率近年呈上升趋势

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列全国死亡登记；推算中国每年新发约4,000–7,000例，多见于55–70岁免疫正常成人及HIV/移植免疫抑制人群
annual_deaths_china.source: 《中国原发中枢神经系统淋巴瘤诊治指南》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 年发病率约0.4–0.5/10万，约95%病理为非生发中心(non-GCB)来源DLBCL，约10%–20%同时累及眼内玻璃体/视网膜（Orphanet ORPHA:46135）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 推算年新发约4,000–7,000例，脑深部白质、基底节及胼胝体为典型好发部位

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 突发重度颅高压或脑疝先兆（剧烈头痛、呕吐、偏瘫、意识模糊）：立即静脉甘露醇脱水降颅压；【核心诊断避坑铁律】在未完成立体定向脑活检获取病理前，除非脑疝迫在眉睫，否则严禁提前大剂量使用糖皮质激素（如地塞米松），因为激素可在数天内让淋巴瘤细胞‘戏剧性溶解消失’，导致活检假阴性、延误救命化疗！; 2) HD-MTX化疗期间密切监测尿量、尿pH(>7.0)及血药浓度，防急性肾衰竭。

standard_drugs.name_zh: 大剂量甲氨蝶呤(HD-MTX，联合利妥昔单抗/替莫唑胺/阿糖胞苷如MATRix/R-MPV)
standard_drugs.drug_class: 可穿透血脑屏障的抗叶酸基石化疗+CD20单抗
standard_drugs.usage_role: 所有适合强化治疗PCNSL患者的一线绝对核心诱导方案（禁止单纯手术切除，以立体定向活检确诊后立即化疗为主）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 甲氨蝶呤、阿糖胞苷、替莫唑胺及国产利妥昔单抗均已集采/入目录，单周期药费约2,000–4,500元
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家药品目录及集采参考价

standard_drugs.name_zh: 泽布替尼 / 奥布替尼 / 伊布替尼
standard_drugs.drug_class: 高透脑血脑屏障BTK抑制剂
standard_drugs.usage_role: 复发难治PCNSL（MYD88/CD79B突变高敏）及老年不耐受强化化疗者联合方案（奥布替尼脑脊液穿透率高，国内获批及指南推荐）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国家谈判后月药费约7,800–9,000元（费用减免前）
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家药品谈判目录参考价(2024–2025)

standard_drugs.usage_role: PCNSL诱导(MATRix)及自体干细胞移植前预处理(TBC/TT-BCNU)核心药物
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 已纳入国家药品目录，但国内部分医院存在阶段性备药协调需求

non_drug_therapies_zh: 确诊首选微创立体定向穿刺活检（广泛开颅切除不仅无法治愈还会增加神经功能缺损）
所有PCNSL患者确诊时必查眼科裂隙灯（排查眼内淋巴瘤）及腰穿脑脊液细胞学/流式/MYD88检测
年轻体能好者诱导缓解后首选自体造血干细胞移植(ASCT)巩固，避免全脑放疗(WBRT)导致的远期痴呆与白质脑病
老年不适合移植者可采用减量全脑放疗或口服BTK抑制剂/来那度胺维持
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: HD-MTX联合诱导化疗全程约6万–12万元；含塞替派预处理自体移植巩固全程约18万–30万元

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 脑脊液IL-10联合MYD88 L265P/ctDNA液体活检成为无创快速诊断与复发监测利器，部分危重深部无法活检患者获益显著; 2) 华山医院/北京协和等国内中心牵头的多项‘大剂量甲氨蝶呤+奥布替尼/泽布替尼+PD-1/来那度胺(OR-MTX)’一线及二线临床试验取得超80%客观缓解率; 3) CD19 CAR-T(Axi-cel/Tisa-cel)在多项国际2期试验中证实可跨越血脑屏障，在复发难治PCNSL中实现50%以上完全缓解且ICANS神经毒性可控。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) >70岁高龄或肾功能不全患者无法耐受HD-MTX，缺乏同等高效低毒的一线替代方案; 2) 约40%–50%患者一线缓解后仍于2年内复发，复发后中位生存仅数月; 3) 术前基层误用糖皮质激素导致活检‘假阴性’延误确诊的现象仍较常见。

aliases_zh: 杂合子/纯合子家族性高胆固醇血症
curated.category: 遗传性脂质代谢与早发心血管病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: LDLR、APOB或PCSK9基因突变导致生来低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）极度升高！若不早筛早治，杂合子（HeFH）男性常在30–40岁、女性40–50岁即突发【青年早发心肌梗死或心源性猝死】（数分钟至数小时内致命！）；纯合子（HoFH）患儿甚至在10–20岁前即发生致命性冠脉闭塞或主动脉瓣狭窄猝死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 自幼或早年确诊后通过高强度他汀+依折麦布联合PCSK9单抗（依洛尤单抗/阿利西尤单抗/托莱西单抗）或小干扰RNA（英克司兰）及ANGPTL3单抗（依维苏单抗用于HoFH），绝大多数杂合子患者可将LDL-C降至安全达标线，大幅推迟或完全避免青年早发心梗猝死。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: 全球死因统计将FH归入“缺血性心脏病/冠心病”，未单列FH独立年度死亡人数；未治疗HeFH患者早发冠心病风险较常人高约10–20倍，HoFH不治疗多在30岁前因心血管事件死亡。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国未单列FH独立死亡数，但中国早发冠心病（男性<55岁、女性<65岁）住院患者中FH检出率显著高于普通人群，因知晓率与基因诊断率极低导致大量可预防的青年猝死。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球杂合子（HeFH）患病率约1/300–1/313（约2,500万–3,000万人），纯合子（HoFH）约1/30万–1/100万。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国PEACE项目等流调估算成人HeFH患病率约0.13%–0.19%（约1/500–1/750，全国患者约270万–700万人，HoFH约2,200–4,600人），但诊断率与达标率均不足5%。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：年轻患者（20–45岁）或有明确高血脂家族史者，若突发胸骨后压榨性剧痛、憋闷大汗、疼痛向左上臂/下颌/后背放射超过15分钟不缓解，立即拨打120按急性心肌梗死抢救！严禁因“年纪轻轻不可能得心脏病”而当成胃痛或劳累硬扛延误溶栓/急诊支架（PCI）黄金时间窗；平时发现眼睑黄色瘤、跟腱增厚结节或体检LDL-C≥4.9 mmol/L务必立即专科排查FH。

standard_drugs.name_zh: 瑞舒伐他汀 / 阿托伐他汀 + 依折麦布
standard_drugs.drug_class: HMG-CoA还原酶抑制剂 + 肠道胆固醇吸收抑制剂
standard_drugs.usage_role: 所有FH患者终身基石联合口服降脂一线治疗
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国家集采后他汀+依折麦布联合月花费约20–80元
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家药品集中带量采购中选结果

standard_drugs.name_zh: 依洛尤单抗 / 阿利西尤单抗 / 托莱西单抗
standard_drugs.drug_class: PCSK9单克隆抗体（每2–4周皮下注射1次，再降LDL-C约50%–60%）

master.definition_en: A rare, genetic neurological disorder characterized by visual seizures and occipital epileptiform paroxysms reactive to ocular opening which present in infancy to mid-adolescence. Vomiting, tonic eye deviation and impairment of consciousness are typically associated with the Panayiotopoulos type, while visual hallucinations, ictal blindness and post-ictal headache are commonly observed in the Gastaut type. Electroencephalographic findings in both types are similar and include bilateral, synchronous, high voltage spike-wave complexes in a normal background activity located predominantly in the occipital lobes.

master.definition_en: Short rib-polydactyly syndrome (SRPS), Beemer-Langer type is an extremely rare type of SRPS developing prenatally or immediately after birth and characterized by short and narrow thorax with horizontally oriented ribs. Other bone features include small iliac bones, short tubular bones, bowing of long bones and rarely pre- and post-axial polydactyly. Brain defects are common and some cases of cleft lip, absent internal genitalia and renal, biliary and pancreatic cysts have been reported. The course is rapidly fatal.

master.definition_en: Scleromyxedema is a rare, severe skin disorder. Signs and symptoms include abnormal accumulation of mucin in the skin (mucinosis), causing papular and sclerodermoid bumps; increased production of fibroblasts (connective tissue cells) in the absence of a thyroid disorder; and monoclonal gammopathy (abnormal proteins in the blood). It often involves internal organs and may affect various body systems. The cause of scleromyxedema is not known. There is no standard treatment. Management may involve the use of intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), plasmapheresis, thalidomide and corticoids, or more aggressive interventions, such as autologous bone marrow transplantation.

master.definition_en: Lipodermatosclerosis refers to changes in the skin of the lower legs. It is a form of panniculitis (inflammation of the layer of fat under the skin). Signs and symptoms include pain, hardening of skin, change in skin color (redness), swelling, and a tapering of the legs above the ankles. The exact underlying cause is unknown; however, it appears to be associated with venous insufficiency and/or obesity. Treatment usually includes compression therapy.

master.definition_en: Any Bernard-Soulier syndrome caused by the variation in the GP9 gene, marked by absent or markedly reduced GPIb-IX-V complex expression, resulting in impaired platelet adhesion and lifelong mucocutaneous bleeding. Platelets are large and functionally deficient, with severely reduced ristocetin-induced agglutination reflecting loss of functional GPIX within the receptor complex.
